title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 7: Shun Di
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．７ 「舜帝」
overview:
Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series is a series of eleven Sega Saturn discs released in Japan between October 1995 and March 1996, each containing images of one Virtua Fighter character.

This disc features Shun Di, born January 2, 1912; China. He is a practitioner of Drunken Kung Fu (Zuì Quán). He debuted in Virtua Fighter 2 along with Lion Rafale.
